name: Fenugreek extract
description: Fenugreek extract (CAS 84625-40-1 ), derived from Trigonella foenum-graecum seeds, is a concentrated botanical ingredient used across food, nutraceutical, and personal care manufacturing. Carrying FEMA 2485 designation, it delivers the characteristic maple-like, slightly bitter flavor profile that defines its commercial value as a flavoring agent and functional ingredient. In food and beverage manufacturing, it functions as a natural flavoring in spice blends, sauces, and meat seasonings, where its distinctive taste profile reduces reliance on artificial flavor systems. Nutraceutical and dietary supplement formulators incorporate it into capsules, powders, and functional foods targeting metabolic and digestive wellness positioning for various consumer markets. Personal care manufacturers use it in scalp treatments and hair care formulations, where its saponin content supports product claims around hair conditioning and scalp health. In animal feed applications, it acts as a palatability enhancer and natural feed additive for livestock and poultry rations, improving intake and overall nutritional efficiency. Fenugreek extract is supplied as a dry powder, liquid extract, or standardized concentrate depending on the application. Common grades include food-grade and standardized botanical extracts. Specifications are typically defined by saponin or 4-hydroxyisoleucine content. Organic-certified material is available for manufacturers targeting clean-label or certified organic end products.
